chunks: In the neighbouring land. But having been conquered they will conquer.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'In the neighbouring land' in Surah Ar-Rum?
ai.summary: This verse (30:3) specifically highlights the defeat of the Romans by the Persians in 'the nearest land' (often identified as Syria or Palestine), serving as a historical sign for the early Muslims who were themselves facing persecution in Mecca. Shia and Sunni scholars alike view this as a miraculous prediction fulfilled within a few years (typically cited as six to nine years), reinforcing the concept of divine timing (maw'eed) and the eventual triumph of the monotheistic cause over polytheistic empires.
